executed_hypothesis.applicability: Symbolic agents with starting healing spells, observable HP/energy/conditions and a cast-menu command interface. The implemented scope is Healers; other identities retain parent behavior.
executed_hypothesis.evaluation_plan: Validate current letters, intervals, resource/reliability guards, pagination, unavailable spells, message interruptions, genuine cast failure, pending direction prompts, bounded recovery from protocol stalls, atomic callbacks, natural recovery observations and restart continuity with focused synthetic tests. Use only the supplied bounded smoke for startup/action protocol. GigaEvo compares all 146 episodes paired by character and trajectory_id, aggregated over 73 identity means, against the current primary parent; inspect Healer and non-Healer gains and regressions, validity, runtime and internal failures. Separate directed input, completed exchange, energy spending and HP change in traces; these are diagnostics, not fitness.
executed_hypothesis.expected_effect: Healers may spend less time exposed at low HP and preserve finite healing resources, potentially improving official progression. This is a hypothesis, not an observed child improvement.
executed_hypothesis.mechanism: Transfer current-menu Healer healing capability onto the natural-recovery receiver: parse validated retention intervals and current letters, traverse bounded observed pages, and retain retry/diagnostic state across worker restarts. Keep the cast transaction atomic through observed intervening message pages, direct at self only on a current direction prompt, and verify prompt completion separately from energy spending or net HP gain. Preserve existing status, potion, prayer and unseen-danger escape priority, natural-recovery ownership and specialized descent exclusions.
risks: Casting can fail or expose the hero to another attack and consume energy/nutrition.
Armor may suppress casting opportunities; forgotten spells are not relearned.
Unknown or multi-page menus can suppress healing; bounded cancellation avoids menu loops.
Existing emergency priority can prefer prayer over an available spell.
The supplied smoke does not include Healers; synthetic tests do not establish live casting success or improved progression.
Natural recovery and spell casting alter timing and resource use together; additive progression benefit is unmeasured.
Unmarked or unknown prompts are conservatively cancelled; bounded stalls can invoke inherited policy resynchronization.
executed_hypothesis.title: Combine observed Healer self-casting with bounded natural recovery

changes: Transferred donor spell retention parsing, rejection reasons, bounded current-page traversal, capped transaction diagnostics and restart adoption. Added bounded More acknowledgements before menus and around self-targeting, completion accounting independent of energy/HP changes, and cancellation that clears newly exposed prompts or raises AgentPanic for resynchronization. Kept receiver natural recovery, descent ownership and emergency ordering. Added adapted donor raw-observation tests plus message/prompt/recovery/atomic regression tests and expanded worker reset checks. Updated the child dossier. Validation: 86 focused tests pass; supplied syntax helper compiles 55 Python files with pre-existing warnings; the single smoke completed two 512-action games with zero reported bot errors in 8.880215 seconds. No child fitness claim.
deviations: No material departure from the selector hypothesis. Prompt continuation and completion checks refine the planned transaction transfer because inspected donor records show ESC after hunger/fading-recall messages spending energy while leaving a direction prompt. No donor exposure policy or broader scheduler change was introduced. Earlier live casting and receiver natural recovery justify testing their previously unevaluated combination; they do not establish an additive benefit. The smoke uses non-Healers and cannot verify live casting. No score-based acceptance fallback, evaluator modification or experiment-memory write was introduced.
